subject: QBR prep: OKR alignment, dependencies, and signal summary
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR kickoff: OKR alignment and top dependencies (draft asks)

Team —

As we start the QBR packet work, I put together a short dependency matrix (attached) and a draft list of signals we should surface for leadership. High-level asks:

- Confirm ownership for the four delivery risks called out in the matrix.
- Validate the two timeline scenarios (nominal vs conservative) for product and infra.
- Identify gating external dependencies (partner integrations, procurements) and current PR status.

What I pulled together in the sheet: a) feature-level owners, b) earliest/target release window, c) failure mode & impact, d) mitigation / contingency. Please review the matrix and add one-line status and ETA in the comments column by EOD Friday.

Attachments: 2026_QBR_dependency_matrix.xlsx

Notes: the two things I'm most worried about are (1) the storage-backed KV cache rollout slipping into the tail of the quarter, which materially increases per-token cost, and (2) the partner integration for SSO that blocks the enterprise pilot. Both are flagged in the sheet.

I'll pull this together into the QBR slide pack once we have confirmations. Planning short sync Friday 10/02 11:00 if that works for everyone.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR kickoff: OKR alignment and top dependencies (draft asks)

Ben —

Thanks for the matrix, reviewed and added inline notes in the comments tab. Quick highlights:

- KV cache work: current dev -> staging runway looks OK but perf validation tests are scheduled the week of 10/12. If those fail we need to push the conservative timeline. Owner: Laura.
- SSO/integration (Atlas): Tom at Alpha Integrations still needs the schema signoff; they are the long pole for the enterprise pilot. I added a row with the integration ticket and referenced their ticket #AI-487.
- Mobile SDK tweaks (OKR: reduce latency tail): small scope but high QA churn; will require a day of soak after canary.

I've attached the risk register snapshot I maintain — I pulled two new items into the QBR doc. Recommend we surface: mitigation and named fallback for each risk (who will flip fallback, when).

Attachments: product_risk_register.pdf

Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR kickoff: OKR alignment and top dependencies (draft asks)

Ben / Laura —

I took a pass on the dependency matrix and added a 'release risk score' column so the execs can quickly scan. Two operational points:

1) Staffing for the KV rollout week (10/19): we currently have two engineers on PTO that week. If QA run is delayed to 10/12 and uncovers infra work, we should either shift the rollout or bring on short-term bench support.

2) Canary plan: for the Atlas enterprise pilot, propose a phased canary (10% then 50% over three days) with automatic fallback to the previous model variant. Tom (cc'd) can confirm if Alpha can accept a phased rollout window.

Action: Tom, can you confirm the integration schema timeline and whether you can support the phased canary?

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Eng Manager, Delivery
Redwood Inference

Subject: QBR packet timeline & meeting invite (please confirm owners)

All —

Thanks for the quick reads. I'm locking down the internal timeline for the QBR packet and the leadership readout:

- Internal draft slides due: Tue 10/06 10:00am PT
- Leadership review: Thu 10/08 2:00pm PT (45m)
- External pilot / Atlas checkpoint: Mon 10/19 (aligned with the canary)

Please confirm by COB Monday 10/05:
- Who will own the single-slide risk summary for each top 4 risk. (Laura / Marissa / Vivek)
- Final timeline scenario we present (nominal vs conservative).
- For Atlas: whether Alpha can support the phased canary (Tom) and procurement timing (Sara / procurement email).

Related links: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C4QBR-dep-matrix (dependency matrix), https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/atlas-health

On the canary: Alpha confirmed they can do a phased rollout and will provide a runbook for the fallback within 48 hours. Tom, please send the runbook and the schema signoff deadlines.
